summary: The dependencies section installs ansible-core, ansible-runner, Python, system packages and collections; ansible_core and ansible_runner each take a package_pip value passed to pip (name, pinned version or URL).
questions: How do I pin ansible-core version in an execution environment?
How do I set the ansible-runner version in ansible-builder?
What does package_pip mean in the dependencies section?
Does ansible-builder install collection dependencies automatically?
